areas.name: Family law
areas.summary: Divorce, child custody and support, protective orders, adoption and paternity.
bring: Photo ID
Marriage certificate and any prenuptial agreement
Recent pay stubs and tax returns
A list of shared property and debts
Any court papers you have received

areas.name: Personal injury
areas.summary: Car and truck accidents, slip and fall, dog bites, medical negligence and wrongful death.
bring: Photo ID
Police or incident report
Photos of the scene and injuries
Medical records and bills if you have them
Insurance letters, including any settlement offer

areas.name: Employment law
areas.summary: Wrongful termination, discrimination, harassment, retaliation and unpaid wages.
bring: Photo ID
Your offer letter or contract
Termination or disciplinary letters
Pay stubs
A timeline of what happened, with dates

areas.name: Estate planning and probate
areas.summary: Wills, trusts, powers of attorney, guardianship for adults, probate and estate administration.
bring: Photo ID
Any existing will, trust or power of attorney
A list of assets and debts
Names and contact details of beneficiaries
For probate: the death certificate

outOfScope.name: Criminal defense
outOfScope.referral: a criminal defense lawyer through your local bar association's referral service, or a public defender if you cannot afford one

outOfScope.name: Immigration
outOfScope.referral: an immigration attorney through your local bar association's referral service

outOfScope.name: Intellectual property
outOfScope.referral: an intellectual property attorney through your local bar association's referral service

outOfScope.name: Tax disputes
outOfScope.referral: a tax attorney or a licensed tax professional

outOfScope.name: Bankruptcy and debt
outOfScope.referral: a bankruptcy attorney through your local bar association's referral service

outOfScope.name: Business formation and contracts
outOfScope.referral: a business attorney through your local bar association's referral service

outOfScope.name: Landlord-tenant and housing
outOfScope.referral: a housing or tenant attorney, or a legal aid office, through your local bar association's referral service

referralNote: Dyzania does not recommend a specific outside lawyer. It points people to their local bar association's referral service.
matchingNotes: Phrases are matched as whole words or phrases in lowercase text. Before matching, 'real estate', 'in custody' and 'police custody' are removed, because they would otherwise hit estate or custody (family). Single common words such as 'will' and 'trust' are deliberately not keywords.
